text.title: Project-Spec Structure Decision Tree
text.summary: Applicability gate first (SDD lifecycle, committed .aidocs/, durable domain model), then location, then the delivery event that triggered the call. Every conclusion references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the project run the SDD lifecycle with a committed `.aidocs/`, live long enough that a per-feature spec is not enough context, and carry a durable domain model (not a one-off script, throwaway prototype, or pure plumbing)?

branch.conclusion: Skip. One-off script or throwaway prototype — overhead exceeds value; pure plumbing / glue code has no durable domain model to capture.

branch.when: q-applies == true AND spec_location != '.aidocs/project-spec/' AND constitution_declares_path == false
branch.conclusion: Create or move the tree to `.aidocs/project-spec/` at the repository (or monorepo / umbrella) root and commit it. Agent-home paths and git-ignored `.aidocs/` are not a source of truth.
Split the monolith into the flat files and routing subdirectories in 05-examples; add the AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md pair to every subdirectory before content.

branch.question: Which delivery event triggered this call?

branch.conclusion: Land the project-spec/ delta in the same PR, or state "no spec impact" with a one-line reason in readiness.md; the reviewer diffs spec against code before merge.
Run the rebuild test (LLM dry-run, step 6 of 04-procedure). A failing assumption list blocks promotion to done/ and blocks the deploy.
Do not run the rebuild test on a calendar. Wait for the next delivery event; a cron-driven test finds drift months deep and becomes a chore.
Run steps 1-3 of 04-procedure: locate at the canonical path, lay out the flat files, add the routing subdirectories with their AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md pairs.

text.example: inputs: {sdd_lifecycle=true, aidocs_committed=true, domain_model=durable, spec_location='.aidocs/project-spec/', event='feature-moving-to-done'} q-applies -> true spec_location_ok -> true q-event -> feature-moving-to-done => conclusion r-rebuild-at-delivery-events: run the LLM dry-run; assumption list clean of user-visible behaviour, API shape, invariants -> move F042 to done/.
